title: UPPERCUT
blurb: Up + heavy. Launch. Master rank adds hang-time and points.

title: ROUNDHOUSE
blurb: After two lights, heavy. The kick is the invoice.

title: FACE STOMP
blurb: Three stomps on a crushed skull. Smash, pop, splash. Brain on three.

title: SPEED VAULT
blurb: Vector called. Hands on the rail, legs through. Easy path is just-jump.

title: KONG / CAT PASS
blurb: Dive the hands. Harder. More points. The Son teaches this for money.

title: DASH VAULT
blurb: Dash into the rail. One foot, one lie about grace.

title: LANDING ROLL
blurb: Vector+. High drop, down or dash on contact. Converts fall into speed.

title: GRAB SLAM
blurb: Throw on a crushed skull becomes a slam. SoR4 wall setup. Rank 1 unlocks.

title: WALL BOUNCE
blurb: Heavies near a wall juggle. Rank 1 unlocks the bounce. Rank 3 is greedy.

title: AIR MIX
blurb: Special in the air. Rank 1 unlocks. The Son already bills for hang-time.

title: TIC-TAC
blurb: Kick off the wall, change direction mid-air. UP at the wall. The Son calls it physics.

title: WALL CLING KICK
blurb: Stick to the wall for a heartbeat, then launch. SPECIAL at the wall.

title: KING KONG JUMPOFF
blurb: Double-hand kong over a gap and keep flying. SPECIAL at the gap. Epic.

title: LAZY VAULT
blurb: Hand on, swing the legs over sideways. Lazy is a lie, it's efficient.

title: REVERSE VAULT
blurb: Turn your back to the box mid-air, hand plant, land facing forward.

title: DOUBLE KONG
blurb: Two hand plants on one long box. The Son's party trick.

title: CAT LEAP
blurb: Jump, catch the wall edge with hands and feet. Hang like a cat.

title: DIVE ROLL
blurb: Dive over, hands first, roll out on the shoulder. Never on the head.

title: FRONT FLIP
blurb: Tuck forward, spot the landing, legs under you.

title: BACK FLIP
blurb: Arms up, chest up, tuck back. Don't look for the floor too early.

title: SIDE FLIP
blurb: Kick the lead leg, rotate sideways, land facing the way you went.

title: PALM SPIN
blurb: Hand on the obstacle, spin a full turn around it.

title: WEBSTER
blurb: Front flip off one leg. Coach-level.

title: GAINER
blurb: A back flip that travels forward. Running gainer = legends.

title: CORK
blurb: Back flip with a full twist. The Son says don't try this at home.

title: AERIAL
blurb: A cartwheel with no hands. Fly sideways.
